question: Which country's AI pass runs where, and what an ally's count sees.

addresses.name: ProcessAI
addresses.comment: **One country's whole AI pass**, read whole on the listing (rva 0x4894E0 to the `ret 4` at 0x489BB5; two earlier `ret 4` exits at 0x489618 and 0x48986A with the body continuing past them - trap 3). In order: (1) nothing while `ai +0x128` (ai_paused, the console's AI pause) or the country's theatres_dirty (CCountry +0x580) is set; (2) the played country (`ai->id == gamestate->player`) has runs_units (+0x2C) cleared; (3) CEU3AI_RefreshUnitDestinations (0x49A800), AI_ManageUndergrounds (0x489E10); (4) a country owning no province and not in exile: CEU3AI_SendLandlessUnitsOnExpedition (0x499A10) and return; (5) firstPass = unit_pass_done (+0xA5) clear - but in a game loaded from a save (gamestate +0xD9C) firstPass is false and theatres_changed (+0xA6) is cleared; (6) every enabled minister on +0x74 is ticked (slot 9) and the foreign minister answers its offers (0x49E010); (7) the played country with automation[6] == 1: DeployFinishedUnits (0x48B300), every hour; (8) the played country of a loaded game with runs_units clear and no unit agent yet: CreateAgentsForPlannedUnits (0x48BEF0); (9) CEU3AI_DisbandTheatrelessHQs (0x489BD0) - a true answer ends the pass; (10) while theatres_changed is set, the strategy's theatres (CCountry +0x570, which is CAIStrategy +0xE4) are walked: the first whose `unit` does not resolve sends the pass on to (11); when every one resolves, CEU3AI_SortUnitsIntoTheatres(ai, isPlayer) - every unit put under the headquarters of the theatre it stands in, by posted detach and attach commands (FINDINGS-agents.md G) - theatres_changed cleared and **return**, so that hour ticks no agent; (11) every unit agent (+0x40) and every invasion agent (+0x50) is ticked through slot 9. Then with hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24 and the country id: (12) at hour 1 of the 1st of a month the failed-invasion areas (+0x94) are freed; at hour id%24 CEU3AI_AssignSeaTargetsToAgents (0x48C140); always CEU3AI_PruneInvasions (0x491BE0) into a local list; (13) a country whose runs_units is clear (the played one): on even hours, for each unit agent CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas (0x495530) and CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion (0x492190) with that agent - and nothing more; (14) every other country: CEU3AI_RecallStrandedLandUnits (0x498870) on the first pass or at hour (id+16)%24; CEU3AI::CreateAgentsForTheatres (0x48AA80); CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans (0x48DCF0, whose answer is always false); at hour id%24 CEU3AI_ChoosePride (0x499C80), CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres (0x48E490) where unit_pass_done is set, CEU3AI::RebuildPriorityProvinces (0x4976E0), RankInvasionAreas(ai, null), CEU3AI_RebuildWeakEnemyPorts (0x4972E0), CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives (0x4980E0), PlanAmphibiousInvasion(ai, list, null); else at hour (id+8)%24 CEU3AI_GatherTransportsForTheatres (0x490DB0), DeployFinishedUnits, AI_ReassignLeaders (0x498EF0); else at hour (id+16)%24 every unit agent's per-type tally (CAIUnit +0x23C) zeroed, CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres (0x48FBB0), CEU3AI_DistributeAirToTheatres (0x48F2B0), and CEU3AI_PromoteLeadersForCommands (0x499280); then CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances(ai, hour == (id+16)%24) and unit_pass_done = 1. Callers: RunAIPass's tbb parallel_for, once a game hour from the frame after the hour turns; CInGameIdler::Enter for a game loaded from a save; a once-per-process multiplayer kick; idler slot 67 (FINDINGS-ai.md). **A single-player new game runs none of it during its two days and first hour.** See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A. **A game just loaded runs two passes for every country at its own hour, before its first hour** (counted in the running game on a save of July 1941, 2026-11-10: 204 passes for 102 countries, all at the save's tick, agent ticks 192 for 96 agents, land blocks 96). Every agent is already there when the first pass begins; unit_pass_done reads 0 and theatres_changed 1 on the first pass and 1 and 0 on the second. Which of the two runs the land block was not logged. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 12. **Each of a load's two passes is a country's whole pass, its ministers ticked in both** (recorded on the running game, 2026-11-16, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 106): the first on the main thread, all 102 countries in the list's order, the second on the worker threads; a minister whose countdown runs out in either and whose hour of the day is the save's works there - at 07:00 on 16 July 1941 Holland's foreign minister (CAIForeignMinister::ExecuteDiploDecisions' scope draw and six of the Lua's `math.random`) and Greece's politics minister (four CCurrentGameState_GetAIRand), both in the second pass, the AI generator's draws 505 to 509. **The hour's passes race** (recorded on the running game, 2026-11-16, FINDINGS-liveread.md section 111): over 72 hours of July 1941 the main thread ran the same six every hour - `---`, REB, Germany, Britain, the Soviet Union and the United States, the first six of the country list - and the rest went to worker threads, Tannu Tuva's beginning before the Soviet Union's in 53 hours and after it in 19. Since CEU3AI::MoveUnit writes a unit's +0x2CC at once, an agent counting an ally's units (CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions' allies half) sees that ally's orders of the hour or not as the threads fall.
addresses.evidence: hoidraws.lua's E lines (ProcessAI's entry, stack pointer and tag) in the recordings wr9, wr10 and wr11: the six tags on the stack AFF308 in every hour of 72; TAN's entry ranked before SOV's in 53. Wrong if an hour is found with another country on the main thread.
addresses.revises: comment - which passes the main thread runs, and the race
